statement: The record for batch B-12 specifies 15,000 rpm, exceeding rotor R-40’s 10,000 rpm rating. I have not started the centrifuge because that speed could cause the rotor to burst and injure nearby people. Please have the run parameters corrected and approved before proceeding.
